case: Presents with 3 hours of sudden left flank pain radiating to the groin, vomiting twice. Pacing the room, unable to sit still, grimacing. HR 104, BP 142/88. Urinalysis shows blood. No known drug allergies. No history of substance use.
Fell from a ladder. Right thigh is deformed and swollen; X-ray shows a closed mid-shaft femur fracture. Guarding the leg, moaning when moved. HR 112, BP 136/84. No known drug allergies.

Known sickle cell disease, presents with diffuse bone pain in back and legs typical of prior crises, started 8 hours ago despite home ibuprofen. Lying still, speaking in short sentences. HR 108, afebrile. No known drug allergies.
Two days of lower back pain after lifting a heavy box. No leg weakness, no numbness, no bladder or bowel symptoms. Walks in slowly, sits stiffly. Vital signs normal. No known drug allergies.

Throbbing unilateral headache with photophobia and nausea for 6 hours, similar to previous migraines. Lying in a dark room, eyes closed. Neurological exam normal. Vital signs normal. No known drug allergies.

Day 1 after laparoscopic appendectomy. Incision pain worse with movement and coughing, limiting walking. Splinting the abdomen when coughing. Wounds clean, vital signs normal. No known drug allergies.
